about: Abilities: what a creature can choose to do. kind is technique (trained or innate action), spell (with tradition, level and, for Orsino spells, school or domain) or natural (a creature's own attack). effect is written in the Kyr effect language; effects is the typed form. Mechanisms of places are hazards in their own modules, not abilities.

attack.name: Weapon attack
attack.effect: Deal (max(0, statMod(#strength) + 1d6)) physical damage to enemy.

cleave.name: Sweeping blow
cleave.effect: Deal (max(0, statMod(#strength) + 1d4)) physical damage to enemies.

venom.name: Venom blade
venom.effect: Deal (1d4) poison damage to enemy. Apply poisoned to enemy for 3 turns.

ambush.name: Backstab
ambush.effect: Deal (max(0, statMod(#dexterity) + 2d4)) physical damage to enemy.

wounding_blow.name: Wounding blow
wounding_blow.effect: Deal (1d4) physical damage to enemy. Apply weakened to enemy for 3 turns.

human_resolve.name: Riverland resolve
human_resolve.effect: Remove weakened from self. Heal (1d3) health to self.

elf_focus.name: Elder focus
elf_focus.effect: Apply blessed to self for 2 turns.

dwarf_guard.name: Stone endurance
dwarf_guard.effect: Apply warded to self for 2 turns.

goblin_feint.name: Warren feint
goblin_feint.effect: Deal (1d4) physical damage to enemy. Apply weakened to enemy for 2 turns unless dexterity save against (11).

bless.name: Bless the company
bless.effect: Apply blessed to party for 3 turns.

bolt.name: Ember bolt
bolt.effect: Deal (max(0, 1d6 + statMod(#intelligence))) fire damage to enemy.

sleep.name: Binding sleep
sleep.effect: Apply stunned to enemies for 1 turn unless wisdom save against (10 + statMod(#intelligence)).

ward.name: Protective ward
ward.effect: Apply warded to self for 3 turns.

source.notes: Exact 1d4 healing; Kyr mana cost replaces spell slots.
Exact 1d2 + level healing; Kyr mana cost replaces spell slots.

resist_fire.name: Resist Fire
resist_fire.description: Grant an ally resistance to fire.
resist_fire.effect: Apply fireproof to ally for 10 turns.

source.notes: Orsino buffs fireproof with its default duration; Kyr lasts ten of the recipient's combat turns and is paid in mana.

fire_ward.name: Fire ward
fire_ward.description: Spend a little strength to ward a companion against fire for about two hours.

source.notes: Kyr technique granted by a ward focus; applies fireproof on the world clock for twelve units.

flame_strike.name: Strike with the Longsword of Flames
flame_strike.description: A burning blade: a piercing cut and a lick of fire.

source.notes: Exact 1d8 piercing + 1d6 fire on hit; Kyr attack roll against 10, not THAC0.

rending_bite.name: Rending bite
rending_bite.effect: Deal (1d6) physical damage to enemy. Apply bleeding to enemy for 2 turns unless constitution save against (11).

rime_bite.name: Rime bite
rime_bite.effect: Deal (2d6) cold damage to enemy. Apply weakened to enemy for 3 turns unless constitution save against (11).

winter_howl.name: Winter howl
winter_howl.effect: Apply stunned to enemies for 1 turn unless wisdom save against (12).

custodian_sweep.name: Bronze sweep
custodian_sweep.effect: Deal (1d6) physical damage to enemies unless dexterity save against (11).

custodian_chain.name: Burial chain
custodian_chain.effect: Deal (1d6) physical damage to enemy. Apply weakened to enemy for 3 turns unless strength save against (12).

source.notes: Exact 1d6 piercing plus the positive strength modifier; Kyr attack roll against 10.

fire_breath.name: Fire breath
fire_breath.description: Fire pours over everyone before the creature. A quick or hardy creature takes half. The fire takes a while to rekindle.

source.notes: Exact 4d6 fire. Orsino uses it as a single-target melee weapon; Kyr breathes it over every opponent with a breath save for half and a three-turn recharge.

slam.name: Slam
slam.description: A heavy body drives into one opponent.

source.notes: Exact 1d6 and Orsino's piercing type (sic) plus the positive strength modifier; Kyr attack roll against 10.
Exact 2d6 + level bludgeoning, no attack roll, as in Orsino.
